findings.reason: ao-update.sh:43 and ao-doctor.sh:31 still fall back to `$(dirname BASH_SOURCE)/..`. After the move that resolves to packages/cli/src/assets, not the repo root, so running either script directly looks for packages/agent-orchestrator and node_modules in the wrong place. The CLI path is not affected because script-runner.ts now always sets AO_REPO_ROOT, and the tests set it too, so nothing covers direct invocation. Severity stays medium.
findings.claim: The relocated scripts keep the old fallback for the repo root. If you run them directly without AO_REPO_ROOT set, they treat packages/cli/src/assets as the repository root and fail.
findings.evidence: Both shell scripts still derive REPO_ROOT from their parent directory, which is now packages/cli/src/assets. Running the updater directly with --smoke-only reproduced MODULE_NOT_FOUND under src/assets/packages/agent-orchestrator/bin/ao.js. The doctor script likewise checks dependencies and builds beneath the incorrect root. The script tests supply AO_REPO_ROOT and therefore bypass this calculation.
